findings.title: Phone contact rows stack and misalign
findings.observed: Each contact is ~137px (name, org, email, Edit/Delete), so 3.5 fit; email x=72, Edit x=85, name x=116; search placeholder cut at "organizat".
findings.smallest_fix: Indent email and Edit/Delete to the name column (x=116) and shorten the placeholder to "Search contacts".

findings.title: Orphaned photo note and mixed dividers in contact editor
findings.observed: "Save the contact first to add a photo." sits between Emails and Phones; Emails/Phones are unruled groups among ruled disclosure rows.
findings.smallest_fix: Move the photo note to the form top (or footer) and give Emails and Phones the same top divider as the disclosures.

findings.title: Phone bulk toolbar wraps 4+2
findings.observed: Read and Print sit alone on a second line, pushing search ~100px down.
findings.smallest_fix: Keep one row: let the action row scroll horizontally like the nav strip, or move Read/Print into an overflow.

findings.title: Phone nav labels differ from desktop rows
findings.scope: phone shell (6 captures; brand shell, not quality)
findings.observed: Strip shows Drafts/Junk/Sent/Trash stand-ins (App.tsx:599); desktop shows Sent Items and no Junk row. Contract: same order and labels below the breakpoint.
findings.smallest_fix: Label the stand-ins from the account's real folder names, or confirm Junk is intentionally phone-only. Label-only; preserve routing.

findings.title: Detached row chevron
findings.observed: Chevron at x≈640 floats between Name and Contact Info; live DOM shows it is the trailing icon of the name button that opens the contact.
findings.smallest_fix: Drop the chevron (the name already reads as the link) or move it to the row end.

findings.title: Reader dialog height
findings.observed: Near-viewport dialog for a three-line message.
findings.smallest_fix: Size the dialog to content up to a max height.

findings.title: Optional taste
findings.observed: Unread bold across subject, sender and date; full angle-bracket addresses in the desktop sender column; Sign in button 46px vs 40px fields; phone compose Trash beside Contacts; plain-text hard wraps on phone reader.
findings.smallest_fix: None required; consider bolding only the subject/sender for unread and showing display names only.

verdict.reason: My frozen Opus overall is 255.4/32 = 7.98125, 8.0 half-up. Every round3 objection is visibly fixed in the stage06 pixels and the ones I could exercise held live: 14px/40px contact controls, adjacent name disclosures, native indeterminate select-all, 16px boxes in 40px labels, compact left-aligned PoW status, 20px phone Appearance gutter with two columns. No screen is broken; the weakest is the phone contacts list (7.5) for its stacked, misaligned rows. Remaining items are small density slips (phone contact rows, editor photo note, phone toolbar wrap) plus optional taste; I do not ask for another round for them. My reviewer variance this round is net negative, so the result is not lifted by re-judging unchanged pixels. Satisfied at the owner's 8.0 bar; not a 9/10 claim. Parent decides progression.
